Data compilation of met station data from Ongava airstrip for the decomposition experiment (2024-2026)

# Overview

This script reads in csv files from the airstrip met station, merges the files, and synthesizes the data.

Created Nov 7, 2026 Heather Throop\
Updated

Raw files are stored in the "MetStationData\L0" folder for this project on Dropbox. This code pulls data from the Dropbox folder and writes figures and csv files to Dropbox as mapped with a config folder.

# L0: Read, Clean, Combine

### Read in and Combine Files

```{r}
#| label: combine-met-station-files

met_dir <- file.path(DERT_Archives, "OngavaDungDecay", "MetStationData")

col_names <- c(
  "datetime",
  "Barometer_hPa", 
  "HighBar_hPa", 
  "LowBar_hPa",
  "AbsolutePressure_hPa",
  "TempC", 
  "HighTempC", 
  "LowTempC",
  "RH", 
  "HighRH",
  "LowRH",
  "DewPointC", 
  "HighDewPointC",
  "LowDewPointC",
  "WetBulbC", 
  "HighWetBulbC", 
  "LowWetBulbC",
  "AvgWindSpeed_kmh",
  "PrevailWindDirection",
  "HighWindSpeed_kmh", 
  "HighWindDirection",
  "WindChillC", 
  "LowWindChillC",
  "HeatIndexC", 
  "HighHeatIndexC",
  "THWIndexC", 
  "HighTHWIndexC", 
  "LowTHWIndexC",
  "WindRun_km", 
  "Rain_mm", 
  "HighRainRate_mm_h",
  "HeatingDegreeDays", 
  "CoolingDegreeDays"
)

files <- list.files(file.path(met_dir, "L0"), pattern = "\\.csv$",
                    full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
stopifnot("No CSV files found in L0 folder" = length(files) > 0)

met_data <- files |>
  set_names(basename(files)) |>
  map_dfr(
    ~ read_csv(.x,
               skip = 6,                 # drop the 6 met-station header rows
               col_names = col_names,
               col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),  # read as text so files bind cleanly
               na = c("", "NA", "---"),
               progress = FALSE),
    .id = "source_file"
  ) |>
  type_convert(guess_integer = FALSE)

met_data <- met_data |>
  mutate(datetime = mdy_hm(datetime, tz = "Africa/Windhoek"))   # "6/1/24 12:45 PM"

tz <- "Africa/Windhoek"

# make an L1 file that only includes data from June 15, 2024 to Oct 15, 2025 (the period of the decomposition experiment)
met_L1 <- met_data |>
  filter(datetime >= ymd("2024-06-15", tz = tz),
         datetime <  ymd("2025-10-16", tz = tz))   # keeps all of Oct 15, 2025

# write the L1 file as a csv
write_csv(
  met_L1 |> mutate(datetime = format(datetime, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = tz)),
  file.path(met_dir, "metdata_L1.csv")
)

```

```{r}
#| label: reduce-met-data

# reduce the met station data to hourly averages for the decomposition experiment period
met_hr <- met_L1 |>
  mutate(datetime = floor_date(datetime, "hour")) |>
  group_by(datetime) |>
  summarise(met_TempC    = mean(TempC, na.rm = TRUE),
            met_RH       = mean(RH, na.rm = TRUE),
            met_Rain_mm  = sum(Rain_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(across(c(met_TempC, met_RH), ~ if_else(is.nan(.x), NA_real_, .x)),
         daytime = hour(datetime) %in% 7:18)    # crude day/night; adjust to season if needed

# full hourly grid for the experiment
grid <- tibble(datetime = seq(ymd_hms("2024-06-15 00:00:00", tz = tz),
                              ymd_hms("2025-10-15 23:00:00", tz = tz),
                              by = "hour")) |>
  left_join(met_hr, by = "datetime") |>
  mutate(daytime = hour(datetime) %in% 7:18)
```

```{r}

kestrel_path <- file.path(DERT_Archives, "OngavaDungDecay", "MicroclimateData",
                          "L2", "Ongava_kestrel_L2_hourlymeans.csv")

kestrel <- read_csv(kestrel_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  transmute(
    microsite = Microsite,
    precip    = WaterTrt,
    datetime  = force_tz(hour, tzone = tz),   # see timezone note below
    TempC     = mean_T,
    RH        = mean_RH
  ) |>
  inner_join(met_hr |> select(-daytime), by = "datetime") |>
  mutate(daytime = hour(datetime) %in% 7:18,
         week    = floor_date(datetime, "week"))

fit_one <- function(d, y, x) {
  f <- reformulate(c(paste0(x, " * daytime")), response = y)
  lm(f, data = d)
}

# blocked CV by week: leave out each week, predict it, pool the errors
cv_rmse <- function(d, y, x) {
  wk <- unique(d$week)
  err <- map(wk, \(w) {
    tr <- filter(d, week != w); te <- filter(d, week == w)
    m  <- fit_one(tr, y, x)
    te[[y]] - predict(m, te)
  }) |> unlist()
  sqrt(mean(err^2, na.rm = TRUE))
}

models <- kestrel |>
  group_by(microsite, precip) |>
  nest() |>
  mutate(
    m_temp = map(data, ~ fit_one(drop_na(.x, TempC, met_TempC), "TempC", "met_TempC")),
    m_rh   = map(data, ~ fit_one(drop_na(.x, RH, met_RH), "RH", "met_RH")),
    r2_temp   = map_dbl(m_temp, ~ summary(.x)$r.squared),
    r2_rh     = map_dbl(m_rh,   ~ summary(.x)$r.squared),
    cvrmse_temp = map_dbl(data, ~ cv_rmse(drop_na(.x, TempC, met_TempC), "TempC", "met_TempC")),
    cvrmse_rh   = map_dbl(data, ~ cv_rmse(drop_na(.x, RH, met_RH), "RH", "met_RH"))
  )

models |> select(microsite, precip, r2_temp, cvrmse_temp, r2_rh, cvrmse_rh)
```

```{r}
kestrel_filled <- models |>
  mutate(pred = pmap(list(m_temp, m_rh), \(mt, mr) {
    grid |>
      mutate(TempC_pred = predict(mt, newdata = grid),
             RH_pred    = predict(mr, newdata = grid))
  })) |>
  select(microsite, precip, pred) |>
  unnest(pred) |>
  left_join(kestrel |> select(microsite, precip, datetime, TempC_obs = TempC, RH_obs = RH),
            by = c("microsite", "precip", "datetime")) |>
  mutate(
    TempC_filled = !is.na(TempC_obs),
    TempC        = coalesce(TempC_obs, TempC_pred),
    TempC_source = if_else(is.na(TempC_obs), "modeled", "observed"),
    RH           = pmin(pmax(coalesce(RH_obs, RH_pred), 0), 100),   # keep RH within 0-100
    RH_source    = if_else(is.na(RH_obs), "modeled", "observed")
  ) |>
  select(datetime, microsite, precip, TempC, TempC_source, RH, RH_source)

# note: rows stay NA where the met station itself had a gap (no predictor available)
kestrel_filled |> count(microsite, precip, TempC_source, is.na(TempC))
```

```{r}
src_cols <- c(observed = "#0072B2", modeled = "#E69F00")

plot_filled <- function(data, y, ylab) {
  ggplot(data, aes(datetime, .data[[y]], color = .data[[paste0(y, "_source")]], group = 1)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE) +
    facet_grid(microsite ~ precip) +
    scale_color_manual(values = src_cols, name = NULL) +
    scale_x_datetime(date_labels = "%b %y", date_breaks = "3 months") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = ylab) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.2))) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "top",
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
}

p_temp <- plot_filled(kestrel_filled, "TempC", "Temperature (°C)")
p_rh   <- plot_filled(kestrel_filled, "RH",    "Relative humidity (%)")

p_temp
p_rh

```

```{r}
daily <- kestrel_filled |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(datetime, tz = tz)) |>
  group_by(microsite, precip, date) |>
  summarise(frac_modeled = mean(TempC_source == "modeled"),
            TempC = mean(TempC, na.rm = TRUE),
            RH    = mean(RH, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(TempC_source = if_else(frac_modeled > 0.5, "modeled", "observed"),
         RH_source    = TempC_source,
         datetime     = as.POSIXct(date, tz = tz))

plot_filled(daily, "TempC", "Daily mean temperature (°C)")
```

```{r}
# ---- 1. Cross-validated predictions for hours with observed Kestrel data ----
cv_preds <- function(d, y, x) {
  d  <- drop_na(d, all_of(c(y, x)))
  wk <- unique(d$week)
  map_dfr(seq_along(wk), \(i) {
    tr <- filter(d, week != wk[i])
    te <- filter(d, week == wk[i])
    te |> mutate(pred = predict(fit_one(tr, y, x), newdata = te))
  }) |>
    transmute(microsite, precip, datetime, obs = .data[[y]], pred)
}

cv_all <- kestrel |>
  group_split(microsite, precip) |>
  map_dfr(\(d) bind_rows(
    cv_preds(d, "TempC", "met_TempC") |> mutate(variable = "Temperature (°C)"),
    cv_preds(d, "RH",    "met_RH")    |> mutate(variable = "Relative humidity (%)")
  ))

# ---- 2. Fit statistics per treatment x variable ----------------------------
cv_stats <- cv_all |>
  group_by(variable, microsite, precip) |>
  summarise(n    = n(),
            bias = mean(pred - obs),
            rmse = sqrt(mean((pred - obs)^2)),
            r2   = cor(pred, obs)^2,
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(label = sprintf("R² = %.2f\nRMSE = %.1f\nbias = %.1f", r2, rmse, bias))

print(cv_stats, n = Inf)

# ---- 3. Predicted vs observed with 1:1 line ---------------------------------
plot_obs_pred <- function(var) {
  ggplot(filter(cv_all, variable == var), aes(obs, pred)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.08, size = 0.6, color = "#0072B2") +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_text(data = filter(cv_stats, variable == var), aes(label = label),
              x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.1, size = 3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    facet_grid(microsite ~ precip) +
    coord_equal() +
    labs(x = paste("Observed Kestrel -", var),
         y = paste("Modeled (cross-validated) -", var)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
}

plot_obs_pred("Temperature (°C)")
plot_obs_pred("Relative humidity (%)")

# ---- 4. Time-series overlay: observed vs modeled over a short window --------
win <- c(ymd("2025-03-01", tz = tz), ymd("2025-03-15", tz = tz))   # adjust to a period with data

cv_all |>
  filter(datetime >= win[1], datetime < win[2]) |>
  pivot_longer(c(obs, pred), names_to = "source", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(source = recode(source, obs = "observed", pred = "modeled")) |>
  ggplot(aes(datetime, value, color = source)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.4) +
  facet_grid(variable ~ microsite + precip, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(observed = "#0072B2", modeled = "#E69F00"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

```
